test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Simplify the expression:

(a + b)/(a - b) div ((a + b)²)/((a² - b²))
solution:
**Given:**

**(a + b)/(a - b) div ((a + b)²)/((a² - b²))**

**Concept used:**

a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b)

**Calculation:**

(a + b)/(a - b) div ((a + b)²)/((a² - b²))

⇒ (a + b)/(a - b) times ((a² - b²))/((a + b)²)

⇒ (a + b)/(a - b) times ((a - b)(a + b))/((a + b)²)

⇒ ((a + b))/((a + b))

⇒ 1

**∴ The required answer is 1.**
